description.text:
The core exchange of a physician assistant is: within defined authorization and the collaboration chain, converting the patient's complaints, history, signs, and test results into an executable, reviewable treatment and follow-up plan; speed must not override patient safety. Converted into PA
deliverables are not just one treatment action but also traceable medical records, orders, prescriptions or procedure records, referral information, follow-up plans, and reliable handover to physicians, nurses, and other professionals. When judging this career path, the work loop, responsibility boundaries, evidence standards, risk control, and observable entry-level work should be verified at the same time.

subject.name: Physician assistants
subject.summary: United States physician assistants (PAs) take histories, examine patients, identify problems, order tests, treat, document, and provide health education within the framework of physician collaboration and each state's rules. They usually need to complete an accredited master's program and obtain a state license; a United States PA-C cannot be converted directly into Chinese physician practice qualifications.
